title: Action-Sport Crash and Big-Impact Log
dataSources: E-bike rides (`ebike:ride`), scooter trips (`scooter:trip`), skate sessions (`skate:session`), surf sessions (`surf:session`), snow runs (`snow:run`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sport trackers — e-bike / e-scooter apps (VanMoof, Bosch eBike Flow), and skate / surf / snow session trackers (Trace, Slopes, Xensr) with IMU sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=skate:session OR sourcetype=snow:run OR sourcetype=surf:session)
| where impact_g>6
| stats count as hard_impacts, max(impact_g) as worst by sport
| sort - worst
description: Flags the hardest impacts across your action-sport sessions, a light-touch safety log for a rough day out.
value: A record of big impacts is useful context after a fall and a gentle prompt to check gear or rest when they pile up.
implementation: Ingest impact data from IMU sensors into `index=personal`; count and rank hard impacts per sport.
visualization: Bar chart of hard impacts by sport with the worst reading.
grandmaExplanation: It flags your hardest falls across board and snow sports, a simple safety log for a rough day.
